newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end up, S&P sets new high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end up, S&P sets new high.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures ended higher after a session of wide-ranging price moves that saw front-month Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 futures pop up and set another all-time price peak for the third consecutive session.

June S&P 500s futures also closed at another new record settlement, although below the day's highest point, after a decent-volume final advance tugged it back up from nearly unchanged to a moderate ending gain and a rich spread to cash.
"It felt like there were a lot of people getting in late," said one floor broker of the last-minute rise. "You get these late (buy) orders...people don't want to miss the rally."
